brief: A 60-second trailer: hook first, the stakes, the turn, no spoilers of the ending

candidates.label: Engine start hook
candidates.reason: Countdown heard: 'We have main engine start, four, three, two, one.' Works as loud trailer hook.

candidates.label: Breakup setup
candidates.reason: Said: 'You're a jerk, Tom.' then 'Look, Celia, we have to follow our passions.' then 'You have your robotics and I just want to be awesome in space.' Establishes conflict.

candidates.label: Robot hand accusation
candidates.reason: Said: 'Why don't you just admit that you're freaked out by my robot hand?' Clear personal stakes line.

candidates.label: Freaked out breakup
candidates.reason: Said: 'I'm not freaked out by it's alright fine I'm freaked out I'm having nightmares that I'm being chased by these giant robotic claws whatever Tom we're done' Turning point ending the relationship.

candidates.label: Memory locked
candidates.reason: Said: 'Robots memory synced and locked' Short tech statement for stakes.

candidates.label: Ready rock star
candidates.reason: Said: 'Are you ready?' 'Of course you're ready.' 'You're a rock star.' Upbeat pump-up moment.

candidates.label: Ten minutes go
candidates.reason: Said: 'How's it looking Barley?' 'We should have about 10 minutes.' 'Well, that's perfect.' 'We're only one.' 'All systems go.' 'Yeah, you go.' Builds countdown pressure.

candidates.label: Move go push
candidates.reason: Said: 'Move your asses.' 'Go go go' 'Come on.' 'on.' 'Go.' Fast urgent action beat.

candidates.label: Be tender love
candidates.reason: Said: 'Tom, there she is.' 'Now, you'll love her.' 'She's your passion.' 'Be, be tender to her.' 'Be honest.' 'be tender.' 'remind her what love is.' The turn without revealing ending.

candidates.label: Action override
candidates.reason: Said: 'And action!' 'Memory override in progress.' 'You're a jerk, Tom.' 'Oh, sorry.' 'sorry.' 'Sorry.' Shows replay demonstration.

candidates.label: Two minutes speed up
candidates.reason: Said: 'Get her coming.' 'Two minutes left.' 'Two minutes.' 'Speed up.' High-stakes countdown.

candidates.label: Destroy the world plea
candidates.reason: Said: 'Listen, Celia,Listen, Celia, I was young.' 'and a dick but that's no reason to destroy the world.' States global stakes.

candidates.label: Tried That Hook
candidates.reason: Says "We already tried that one." then "You broke my heart." Strong cold open.

candidates.label: Crush Threat
candidates.reason: Says "I You forgot me on Earth." then "I know." then "I should just crush you."

candidates.label: Apology Beat
candidates.reason: Includes "I'm" then "I'm sorry." Quiet character beat.

candidates.label: Not My Fault
candidates.reason: Says "Good ad lib." then "Not my fault."

candidates.label: Time Pressure
candidates.reason: Says "this time." then "One sec." then "A lot of time, a lot of time."

candidates.label: Silent Build
candidates.reason: No transcript dialogue in this range; hold for pacing between lines.

candidates.label: Lead To Alert
candidates.reason: No transcript dialogue in this range; bridge into stakes.

candidates.label: Abort Stakes
candidates.reason: Says "Memory overread at 90%." then "Captain, we have to abort." then "abort."

candidates.label: Aftermath Pause
candidates.reason: No transcript dialogue in this range; pause after abort call.

candidates.label: World Changed Turn
candidates.reason: Says "The world's changed, Celia." then "Maybe we can too." then "Memory override complete."

candidates.label: Pre Lesson Hold
candidates.reason: No transcript dialogue in this range; hold before closing reflection.

candidates.label: Lesson Ending
candidates.reason: Says "You know, there's a lesson to to be learned from this." then "Could have gone worse." Ending spoiler, avoid for trailer.
